race.comment: ENCROACHING (11) won well two back before a 1.3L defeat last start behind Tex 'N' Cee at Belmont where he hit the line locked together with PROPERATA. Drawn wider this time, but gets a weight swing in his favour and has the speed to offset the draw. Can sit up front and will take plenty of catching. JACKPOT BINGO (6) never featured first-up before a better effort last start when closing well from the back of the pack. Third-up now and the slight rise in trip should help. Can feature. DEFENDING (1) was better last start and has claims on the back of that performance. NOAHQUINTILLY (4) has to be included on a solid last start victory.
